QUOTE: `handleChannelDeletedEvent`) | Keeps the channel in the DB as archived | If it is the current channel, kicks the user with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`, then removes membership

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: Row 2 states that when archived channels are not viewable the current-channel user is kicked and membership removed, and that when viewable the channel is kept as archived. Row 1 also covers the removal.
